title: TypeSomething hero (v2)
description: A centred hero on warm paper with a soft pink glow top-left and a lime glow top-right: a small announcement pill, a huge light-weight two-line headline with very tight tracking, a typewriter line (a bold verb, then phrases that type and erase behind a blinking underscore), a paragraph and two pill buttons. A white feature strip with three icon cells and a long soft shadow closes it.
notes: needs JavaScript for the typewriter (hydrate: load); static HTML shows the first phrase
with reduced motion the first phrase stays and the cursor holds still
best on light themes: the glows are the highlight and primary colours
name: typesomething-v2-hero
